params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows), single warm key light, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, matte dark surfaces, thin haze, fine golden dust. The upper 50% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography.
